High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Kessel (Dark) (Errata)]] (the card with its Decipher errata text and the errata mark) (Premiere Limited, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Kessel _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/12R6swTaA4MEEUt9SXdgSbV6P6qw3iPEt/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Kessel _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,341,676 bytes, SHA-256 <code>1f36f23664f7d38a30aebcbb4b573d1222c5ef1a9e460f4d8784a9cf0dcbbeaf</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.5, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

This credited print-ready fan rendition is preserved as an explicit qualified comparison at [[Kessel (Dark) (Errata)]], not an automatic high-resolution scan of its historical document source. The actual published Dark-side entry is [[:File:Kessel-Dark-Decipher-Supplement-2002-p5-entry.png]]. The fan image’s gold E mark does not appear in that entry and does not create an additional official image ordinal. The original TIFF provenance and image credit remain unchanged.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.. It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
